references.text: Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, is mentioned here with his new name given to him in 6:32
The name Jerubbaal is used again, referring to the naming in 6:32
Abimelech is identified as the son of Jerubbaal, the name Gideon received after tearing down Baal's altar
Jerubbaal's sons are mentioned, with reference to the name given in 6:32
Jerubbaal (Gideon) is mentioned as one of the judges the Lord sent to save Israel
The name Jerubbesheth is a variant of Jerubbaal, where 'Baal' has been replaced by 'bosheth' (shame)
The context for the naming: Gideon tore down Baal's altar and the Asherah pole, which led to the name Jerubbaal
